meta.title: Precomputed deep-dive prompts
meta.note: Suggested prompts copied from the assistant personas (assets/chat.js). scripts/generate_answers.py answers each one with Claude, grounded on data/research, and writes data/answers/<slug>.json. Optional per-prompt "datasets" overrides the keyword mapping. Wording follows scripts/term_map.json ("growth plan", "portfolio company"); optional "aliases" keep older wording matching the same deep dive.
